the Funtional table divided into 7 fra,es each mapping to a column
    1. checkbox 
        1.1 column header with checkbox icon set
        1.2 multiple column rows wuth checkbox IconSet

    2. orderid 
        2.1 column header -> order id
        2.2 multiple column rows with text frames

    3. user
        3.1 column header wit text user 
        3.2 multiple content column rows
            3.2.1 iconSet with icon 
            3.2.2 text  
    4. project 
        same as order id column
    
    5.address
        5.1 column header 
        5.2 multiple column rows with content within
            5.2.1 the content frame has text within it
            5.2.2 next to text there is iconset which appears only when the row is hovered over with svg

    7.status
        header 
        multiple content column rows with
            icon badge that has colored dot icon within
            tag text
        the text and dot icon have varius colors based on the status
          e.g in light theme complete is #4AA785 and approved is #FFC555
